title: Fishbrain Catch Window by Weather Band
dataSources: Catch trips (`outdoor:trip`), hunt map activity (`hunt:map`), foraging observations (`forage:observation`), smoker sessions (`cook:smoker`), harvest queues (`outdoor:queue`).
app: Fishing, hunting, foraging, and outdoor-cooking telemetry — Fishbrain catch logs, onX Hunt map exports, iNaturalist observations, and ThermoWorks smoker probes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outdoor:trip platform="fishbrain" weather_band=* catch_window_min=*
| stats avg(catch_window_min) as avg_catch_window_min, count as events by weather_band
| sort - avg_catch_window_min
description: Shows average catch-window minutes by weather band for catch timing.
value: Average catch-window minutes by weather band helps compare catch timing across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `catch_window_min` on `outdoor:trip` events and normalize `weather_band` so Splunk can summarize performance by weather band.
visualization: Bar chart of average catch-window minutes by weather band.
grandmaExplanation: It records the average catch-window minutes for each weather band so you can see what works best for catch timing.
